source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: the Chapter 17 exercise solved (PDF 115-117, printed 111-113): MCQ keys worked out, model answers, numericals step by step, with Kitab ki ghalti and Wazahat boxes.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 17 (Alternating Current) ki exercise hai, kitab ki tarteeb mein, hal ke saath. Har MCQ ke saath sahi jawab aur wajah hai; short, constructed aur comprehensive sawalon ke model jawab (poore number wale) aur numerical problems ka qadam ba qadam hal diya gaya hai. Jahan zaroorat hai, "Wazahat" box mein aasan alfaaz mein samjhaya gaya hai.
Multiple Choice Questions (kai jawabon mein se sahi chunein)
Choose the correct answer. (sahi jawab chunein)

blocks.prompt:
17.1 Name of device that is used as a part of charging circuit for mobile phones is:
(Mobile phone ke charging circuit ka hissa kaun sa device hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Mobile charger mein full-wave bridge rectifier hota hai. Yeh ghar ki AC ko DC mein badalta hai, kyun ke battery DC hi store karti hai (17.14).

blocks.prompt:
17.2 A 10 μF capacitor is plugged into a 110 Vᵣₘₛ, 60 Hz voltage source, with an ammeter in series. The value of Iᵣₘₛ that passes through the capacitor is:
(10 μF ka capacitor 110 Vᵣₘₛ, 60 Hz source se jora gaya hai aur series mein ammeter laga hai. Capacitor mein se guzarne wala Iᵣₘₛ kitna hai?)

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Option (d) mein "0.0415 Ma" chhapa hai; milliampere ka symbol mA hai (Ma to mega-ampere parha jaye ga). Waise bhi 0.0415 mA jawab nahi; sahi jawab (b) 0.415 A hai.

blocks.prompt:
17.3 In an RC-circuit a 10 kΩ resistance is connected in series to a capacitor of 0.05μF. The applied voltage for charging is 36 V, the RC-time constant to charge capacitor is:
(RC-circuit mein 10 kΩ resistance 0.05 μF capacitor ke saath series mein hai; charging voltage 36 V hai. Capacitor charge karne ka RC-time constant kitna hai?)
blocks.explanation: Time constant τ = RC = (10 × 10³ Ω)(0.05 × 10⁻⁶ F) = 5 × 10⁻⁴ s = 0.5 ms. Yeh 36 V par depend nahi karta. Koi option bilkul 0.5 ms nahi; sab se qareeb (c) 0.549 ms hai, isi ko jawab mana gaya hai (neeche box dekhein).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kisi option mein sahi time constant nahi: τ = RC = 0.5 ms. Option (c) 0.549 ms = RC × ln 3 hai, yani woh waqt jis mein capacitor 36 V ke 2/3 (24 V) tak charge hota hai; yeh time constant nahi. Phir bhi kitab ka iraada (c) hai, is liye (c) ko jawab rakha gaya hai.

blocks.prompt:
17.4 In a purely inductive or capacitive circuit, the average power consumed is:
(Sirf inductor ya sirf capacitor wale circuit mein average power kitni kharch hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Voltage aur current mein 90° ka farq hota hai, is liye P = VI cos 90° = 0. Ek quarter-cycle mein field mein jama energy agle quarter-cycle mein source ko wapas mil jati hai (17.6, 17.8).

blocks.prompt:
17.5 Through which of the AC-circuit elements both emf and current are in phase?
(AC circuit ke kis element mein emf aur current dono in phase (ek saath) hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Resistor mein V = Vₒ sin ωt aur I = Iₒ sin ωt; dono ek hi waqt maximum aur minimum hote hain (17.5). Inductor mein current 90° peeche aur capacitor mein 90° aage hota hai.

blocks.prompt:
17.6 An inductor with a reactance of 120 Ω, a capacitor with a reactance of 150 Ω and a 24 Ω resistance are connected in series across a 220 V source. When the circuit is at resonance, then voltage across the inductor is:
(120 Ω reactance wala inductor, 150 Ω reactance wala capacitor aur 24 Ω resistance 220 V source par series mein hain. Resonance par inductor ke across voltage kitni hogi?)
blocks.explanation:
Resonance par X_L aur X_C ek doosre ko cancel kar dete hain, is liye Z = R = 24 Ω.
I = V/R = 220 V/24 Ω = 9.17 A
V_L = I X_L = 9.17 A × 120 Ω = 1100 V = 1.1 kV.
Inductor ki voltage source se 5 guna zyada hai (voltage amplification, 17.12).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Resonance par X_L = X_C hota hai, magar sawal 120 Ω aur 150 Ω deta hai. Kitab ka iraada: resonance par Z = R aur X_L = 120 Ω le kar 1.1 kV (b). (Agar dono reactances waqai yahi hon to circuit resonance par nahi: Z = √(24² + 30²) = 38.4 Ω aur V_L = 687 V, jo kisi option mein nahi.) Option (b) mein unit "KV" chhapi hai; sahi symbol kV hai.

blocks.prompt:
17.7 If magnetic field is doubled in an inductor, then, magnetic energy density becomes:
(Inductor mein magnetic field double ho jaye to magnetic energy density kitni ho jati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Energy density = B²/2μₒ (Eq. 17.38), yani B² ke mutabiq. B double karne se (2)² = 4 guna ho jati hai.

blocks.prompt:
17.8 RC-time constant is measured in:
(RC-time constant kis unit mein naapa jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: RC ki unit ohm × farad = (V/A)(C/V) = C/A = C/(C s⁻¹) = second hai.

blocks.prompt:
17.9 Resonance frequency of RLC-series circuit is fᵣ.If the capacitance is made 4 time the initial value, then the resonance frequency becomes:
(RLC-series circuit ki resonance frequency fᵣ hai. Capacitance 4 guna kar di jaye to resonance frequency kya ho jaye gi?)
blocks.explanation: fᵣ = 1/(2π√LC), yani fᵣ ∝ 1/√C. C ko 4 guna karne se fᵣ' = fᵣ/√4 = fᵣ/2, yani aadhi.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Sawal mein "4 time" chhapa hai; matlab hai "4 times" (4 guna).

blocks.prompt:
17.10 The magnitude of mutual inductance M between two coils when current changes at 20 A s⁻¹ in one coil induces an emf of 50 mV in the other is:
(Ek coil mein current 20 A s⁻¹ ki rate se badalne par doosri coil mein 50 mV emf paida hoti hai; dono coils ki mutual inductance M kitni hai?)

blocks.text: Short Answer Questions (mukhtasar jawab wale sawal)

blocks.prompt:
17.1 What impacts does resistance have on capacitance?
(Resistance ka capacitance par kya asar hota hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Resistance capacitance ko khud nahi badalti (C plates ke area, faasle aur dielectric par depend karta hai).
Magar circuit mein asar parta hai: bari R se capacitor dheere charge aur discharge hota hai (time constant τ = RC), aur AC mein impedance Z = √(R² + X_C²) barhti hai aur phase lead θ = tan⁻¹(1/ωCR) kam hoti hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Time constant RC woh waqt hai jis mein capacitor apni final voltage ka taqreeban 63% charge ho jata hai. R ya C jitna bara, charging utni dheemi. (Time constant ki yeh tafseel chapter 17 mein nahi, chapter se aage ki hai.)

blocks.prompt:
17.2 What happens when an AC line touches a DC line?
(Jab AC line DC line se chhoo jaye to kya hota hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Dono supplies aapas mein short-circuit ho jati hain: DC line par AC voltage charh jati hai, yani us mein badalti hui (DC + AC) voltage aa jati hai.
Bohat bara current behta hai: chingariyan (sparking), garmi, fuse urna ya breaker trip hona, aur DC aalaat (battery, rectifier, electronics) kharab hona; shock ka khatra bhi hota hai. (chapter se aage)

blocks.prompt:
17.3 What is the difference between peak to peak and amplitude in case of sine wave?
(Sine wave mein peak to peak value aur amplitude mein kya farq hai?)
blocks.explanation: Amplitude zero se ek peak tak hota hai; peak-to-peak value positive peak se negative peak tak hoti hai, is liye Vₚ₋ₚ = 2Vₒ.

rows: Zero line se wave ki sab se oonchi value
Positive peak se negative peak tak ka poora faasla
Misaal: 220 V mains ke liye Vₒ = 311 V

blocks.prompt:
17.4 Why are RC circuits used in timing circuits?
(RC circuits timing circuits mein kyun istemal hote hain?)
blocks.explanation:
Capacitor resistor ke zariye ek muqarrar aur pehle se maloom rate par charge aur discharge hota hai, jo time constant τ = RC tay karta hai.
R aur C chun kar jitna chahein delay (der) hasil kar sakte hain; is liye RC circuits timers, delay circuits, blinking lights aur oscillators mein lagte hain. (chapter se aage)

blocks.prompt:
17.5 Why are choke coils preferred over resistors for limiting current in AC circuits?
(AC circuits mein current kam karne ke liye resistor ke bajaye choke coil kyun behtar hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Choke ki inductive reactance X_L = 2πfL bari hoti hai magar resistance na hone ke barabar, is liye power factor cos θ ≈ 0 (θ ≈ 90°).
Yeh current kam karti hai magar garmi mein power taqreeban zaya nahi hoti; resistor current kam karte hue energy I²R garmi bana kar zaya karta hai.

blocks.prompt:
17.6 Define rms values of voltage and current with their phasor diagrams.
(Voltage aur current ki rms values ki tareef phasor diagrams ke saath likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
rms current: woh constant (DC) current jo resistor mein utni hi power (garmi) de jitni AC deta hai; Iᵣₘₛ = Iₒ/√2 = 0.707 Iₒ. Isi tarah rms voltage: Vᵣₘₛ = Vₒ/√2 = 0.707 Vₒ.
Phasor diagram: har quantity ek vector hai jo ω ke saath anticlockwise ghoomta hai; us ki lambai peak (ya rms = 0.707 × peak) value hai. Resistor mein V aur I ke phasors ek hi line par hote hain (in phase).

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Phasor diagram banane ka tareeqa: O se ek horizontal arrow OI (current) banayein. Resistor ke liye voltage ka arrow OV bhi isi line par (lambai Vᵣₘₛ). Dono arrows ω ke saath anticlockwise ghoomte hain; kisi waqt arrow ka vertical hissa (projection) instantaneous value deta hai.

blocks.prompt:
17.7 Resonance in LRC-circuits has various applications, give any four of them.
(LRC circuits mein resonance ke kai istemal hain; koi chaar likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Radio aur TV receiver ko kisi station ki frequency par tune karna.
2. Communication devices mein band-pass filters (chuni hui frequencies guzarna, baqi rokna).
3. Series LRC circuit mein voltage amplification (V_L aur V_C source se zyada).
4. Induction cooktops aur induction heating (parallel LRC circuit; current magnification bhi).

blocks.text: Constructed Response Questions (wazahati jawab wale sawal)

blocks.prompt:
17.1 What do you mean by rating of electrical appliances? Explain briefly.
(Electrical appliances ki rating se kya muraad hai? Mukhtasar wazahat karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Rating woh values hain jo company appliance par likhti hai (power watts mein, chalne ki voltage, aksar current aur frequency bhi), jin par woh mehfooz aur theek kaam karta hai.
Misaal: "1000 W, 250 V" heater 250 V par har second 1000 J energy leta hai; tab current I = P/V = 4 A hota hai (Example 17.3).
Zyada voltage par appliance garam ho kar kharab ho sakta hai; kam voltage par power kam milti hai. Rating se sahi fuse aur wire chunne aur bijli ka kharch (kWh = kW × ghante) nikalne mein madad milti hai.

blocks.prompt:
17.2 The energy stored in an inductor is analogous to the kinetic energy of a moving mass? Justify.
(Inductor mein jama energy chalti hui mass ki kinetic energy jaisi hai? Saabit karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Haan. Inductor ki energy Uₘ = ½LI² bilkul kinetic energy K.E. = ½mv² jaisi hai: inductance L mass m ki jagah hai aur current I velocity v ki jagah.
Jaise mass (inertia, jumood) velocity ki tabdeeli ki mukhalifat karti hai, waise inductance current ki tabdeeli ki mukhalifat karti hai (back emf ε = −L ΔI/Δt). Current barhane ke liye work karna parta hai jaise mass ki speed barhane ke liye; yeh energy magnetic field mein jama rehti hai aur current kam hone par wapas mil jati hai, jaise rukti hui cheez apni K.E. wapas deti hai.

rows: L current ki tabdeeli rokti hai (back emf)
m velocity ki tabdeeli rokti hai (inertia)

blocks.prompt:
17.3 What are safety measures to take when working with AC or DC?
(AC ya DC ke saath kaam karte hue kaun si hifazati tadabeer (safety measures) zaroori hain?)
blocks.explanation:
1. Circuit par kaam se pehle supply band karein (fuse nikalein ya breaker off karein) aur tester se check karein ke current nahi.
2. Insulated (ghair-mosil) handles wale auzaar, rubber ke dastane aur jootay istemal karein, sookhi insulating mat par kharay hon; geelay hathon se kaam na karein.
3. Appliances ki metal body ko earth karein; sahi rating ke fuse, circuit breaker aur earth-leakage breaker lagayein.
4. Sahi current rating ki wires aur plugs lagayein; socket par zyada load na dalein, kharab insulation badal dein.
5. Jahan mumkin ho kam voltage istemal karein (jaise 12 V AC doorbell); kam voltage se shock ka khatra kam hota hai.
6. DC circuit mein bare capacitors ko chhoone se pehle discharge karein; batteries ko ehtiyat se rakhein (short-circuit se chingari aur garmi).
7. Ek haath circuit se door rakhein taake current seene aur dil se na guzre. (zyada tar chapter se aage)

blocks.prompt:
17.4 When the frequency is at “off resonance” in LCR-series circuit, the voltages across the inductor and capacitor can be significantly larger than the source voltage? Justify.
(LCR-series circuit mein frequency "off resonance" ho to bhi kya inductor aur capacitor ki voltages source voltage se kaafi zyada ho sakti hain? Saabit karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Haan. V_L = IX_L aur V_C = IX_C, magar V_L current se 90° aage aur V_C 90° peeche hai, yani dono mein 180° ka farq hai aur yeh ek doosre ko ghatati hain:
V = √(V_R² + (V_L − V_C)²)
Source sirf farq V_L − V_C deta hai, jab ke V_L aur V_C alag alag bohat bari ho sakti hain. Aisa tab hota hai jab X_L aur X_C impedance Z = √(R² + (X_L − X_C)²) ke muqable mein bari hon, yani resonance ke qareeb bhi aur resonance par bhi.
Misaal: R = 24 Ω, X_L = 120 Ω, X_C = 150 Ω, 220 V (resonance nahi): Z = √(24² + 30²) = 38.4 Ω, I = 220 V/38.4 Ω = 5.73 A, V_L = 5.73 A × 120 Ω = 687 V aur V_C = 5.73 A × 150 Ω = 859 V; dono 220 V se kaafi zyada.
Resonance se bohat door (jab ek reactance doosri se bohat bari ho) yeh asar kam ho jata hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Sochein ke V_L aur V_C do log hain jo ek rassi ko ulti simt mein kheench rahe hain: dono bohat zor laga rahe hain magar rassi sirf farq ki taraf hilti hai. Isi tarah coil aur capacitor par alag alag bari voltage hoti hai magar source ko sirf farq dena parta hai.

blocks.prompt:
17.5 How does self-induction manifest when a current is switched on or off in a circuit?
(Circuit mein current on ya off karte waqt self-induction kaise zahir hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Self-induction: coil mein badalta current usi coil mein emf paida karta hai, ε_L = −L ΔI/Δt, jo tabdeeli ki mukhalifat karti hai (Lenz's law).
Switch on: current zero se barhna shuru hota hai; back emf is barhne ko rokti hai, is liye current foran nahi balke aahista aahista apni poori value tak pohanchta hai (bari coil ke saath laga bulb der se jalta hai).
Switch off: current bohat tezi se zero hota hai, is liye ΔI/Δt bohat bara aur bari emf paida hoti hai jo asal current ki simt mein hoti hai aur use jaari rakhna chahti hai; switch ke contacts par chingari (spark) ban sakti hai. Magnetic field mein jama energy ½LI² nikal jati hai.

blocks.prompt:
17.6 Is it possible to achieve mutual inductance using a combination of four coils? If yes, justify your answer.
(Kya chaar coils ke combination se mutual inductance hasil ho sakti hai? Agar haan, to wajah batayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Haan. Mutual induction ke liye sirf yeh zaroori hai ke ek coil ka badalta magnetic flux doosri coil se guzre; coils ki ginti se farq nahi parta.
Chaar coils mein (maslan ek primary aur teen secondary ek hi soft-iron core par, jaise kai windings wala transformer) primary ka badalta current baqi teeno mein emf paida karta hai: har jori ke liye εₛ = −M ΔIₚ/Δt.
Har do coils ki apni mutual inductance M hoti hai jo turns, area, faasle, rukh (orientation) aur core ke material par depend karti hai (17.17). Common iron core se sab coils taqreeban ek jaisa flux share karti hain aur coupling mazboot hoti hai.

blocks.prompt:
17.7 The currents of the order of 0.1 A through human body is fatal what causes death; heating due to current or something else?
(Insani jism mein 0.1 A ke qareeb current jaan leva hota hai; maut garmi (heating) se hoti hai ya kisi aur wajah se?)
blocks.explanation:
Asal wajah garmi nahi. 0.1 A se jism mein I²R garmi sirf chand watts hoti hai, jo itni jaldi maut ke liye kaafi nahi.
Maut is liye hoti hai ke current jism ke electrical signals mein dakhal deta hai: dil chhoti electric pulses se chalta hai; seene se guzarne wala taqreeban 0.1 A ka current dil ki dharkan ka nizaam bigaar deta hai (ventricular fibrillation, dil ka be-tarteeb larazna), aur dil khoon pump karna band kar deta hai. Saans ke muscles bhi mafluj (paralyse) ho sakte hain. 50 Hz AC khaas tor par khatarnak hai kyun ke us ki frequency dil ki apni pulses ko bigaarti hai. (ventricular fibrillation ki istilah chapter se aage hai)

blocks.text: Comprehensive Questions (tafseeli sawal)

blocks.prompt:
17.1 Explain the behaviour of a capacitor is an AC circuit. Derive the expression for capacitive reactance and discuss why current leads the voltage by 90° or π/2 rad.
(AC circuit mein capacitor ka rawaiya bayan karein. Capacitive reactance ka formula derive karein aur batayein ke current voltage se 90° (π/2 rad) aage kyun hota hai.)
blocks.explanation:
AC mein capacitor ka rawaiya:
Capacitor ki plates ke darmiyan insulating medium hota hai, is liye DC nahi guzarti. AC source par voltage ulatne ke saath capacitor pehle ek simt aur phir doosri simt mein charge hota hai; wires mein electrons aage peeche harkat karte hain, yani circuit mein alternating current behta hai. Capacitor energy electric field mein jama karta hai.
Derivation:
Applied voltage: V = Vₒ sin ωt   (17.18)
Kisi bhi lamhe charge: q = CV = CVₒ sin ωt
Current: I = Δq/Δt = CVₒ (Δ/Δt)(sin ωt)
Chunke (Δ/Δt) sin ωt = ω cos ωt:
I = ωCVₒ cos ωt
Chunke cos ωt = sin (ωt + π/2) aur ωCVₒ = Iₒ:
I = Iₒ sin (ωt + π/2)   (17.19)
Capacitive reactance:
X_C = Vᵣₘₛ/Iᵣₘₛ = 0.707Vₒ/0.707Iₒ = Vₒ/Iₒ
Chunke Iₒ = ωCVₒ:
X_C = Vₒ/ωCVₒ = 1/ωC = 1/2πfC   (unit: ohm)
Kam frequency par X_C bari (DC, f = 0 par infinite) aur zyada frequency par chhoti; is liye capacitor DC rokta hai aur AC guzarta hai; zyada frequency par current zyada.
Current 90° aage kyun:
V = Vₒ sin ωt aur I = Iₒ sin (ωt + π/2) ka muqabla karein: current har value voltage se quarter-cycle (T/4) pehle hasil karta hai. Wajah: current charge ke behne ki rate hai, I = Δq/Δt = C ΔV/Δt. Jab V = 0 ho aur barh rahi ho to voltage sab se tez badalti hai, is liye charge sab se tez plates par aata hai: current maximum. Jab V peak par ho to capacitor poora charge hai aur charge lamhe bhar ke liye nahi badalta: current zero. Is liye current hamesha voltage se 90° (π/2 rad) pehle peak karta hai. Phasor diagram mein current ka vector voltage ke vector se 90° anticlockwise aage banta hai.
Power: pure capacitor mein average power zero (P = VI cos 90° = 0); ek quarter-cycle mein electric field mein jama energy agle quarter-cycle mein source ko wapas mil jati hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Sawal mein "capacitor is an AC circuit" chhapa hai; matlab hai "in an AC circuit" (AC circuit mein).

blocks.prompt:
17.2 Explain the behaviour of an inductor is an AC circuit. Derive the expression for inductive reactance and explain why current lags behind the voltage by 90° or π/2 rad.
(AC circuit mein inductor ka rawaiya bayan karein. Inductive reactance ka formula derive karein aur batayein ke current voltage se 90° (π/2 rad) peeche kyun rehta hai.)
blocks.explanation:
AC mein inductor ka rawaiya:
Inductor (coil, choke) ki self-inductance bari aur resistance na hone ke barabar hoti hai. Is mein badalta current back emf paida karta hai jo tabdeeli ko rokti hai, is liye yeh AC ki mukhalifat karta hai. Yeh energy magnetic field mein jama karke wapas kar deta hai, is liye pure inductor mein average power zaya nahi hoti. DC (f = 0) ke liye yeh conductor hai.
Derivation:
Current: I = Iₒ sin ωt   (17.13)
Back emf: ε = L ΔI/Δt; current qaim rakhne ke liye applied voltage is ke barabar honi chahiye:
V = L (Δ/Δt)(Iₒ sin ωt) = LIₒ (Δ/Δt) sin ωt   (17.14)
Chunke (Δ/Δt) sin ωt = ω cos ωt:
V = ωLIₒ cos ωt
Chunke ωLIₒ = Vₒ aur cos ωt = sin (ωt + π/2):
V = Vₒ sin (ωt + π/2)   (17.15)
Inductive reactance:
X_L = Vᵣₘₛ/Iᵣₘₛ = 0.707Vₒ/0.707Iₒ = Vₒ/Iₒ
Chunke Vₒ = ωLIₒ:
X_L = ωLIₒ/Iₒ = ωL = 2πfL   (17.17)   (unit: ohm)
X_L frequency aur L ke seedha mutanasib (directly proportional) hai: DC (f = 0) par X_L = 0 aur zyada frequency par X_L bari. Is liye inductor DC guzarta hai aur high-frequency AC rokta hai.
Current 90° peeche kyun:
I = Iₒ sin ωt aur V = Vₒ sin (ωt + π/2) ka muqabla karein: voltage har value current se quarter-cycle (T/4) pehle leti hai, yani current 90° peeche hai. Wajah: inductor ki voltage L ΔI/Δt hai, yani I-t graph ka slope (dhalaan). Jab current zero ho (axis paar kar raha ho) to slope sab se zyada, is liye voltage maximum; jab current peak par ho to slope zero, is liye voltage zero. Back emf current ki har tabdeeli rokti hai, is liye current voltage lagne ke baad hi barhta hai aur hamesha voltage se 90° (π/2 rad) baad peak karta hai. Phasor diagram mein current ka vector voltage ke vector se 90° peeche hota hai.
Power: average power zero (P = VI cos 90° = 0); ek quarter-cycle mein magnetic field mein jama energy agle mein wapas. Is liye inductor (choke) energy zaya kiye baghair AC control karta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Sawal mein "inductor is an AC circuit" chhapa hai; matlab hai "in an AC circuit" (AC circuit mein).

blocks.prompt:
17.3 Define RLC-parallel circuit. Also write its key properties.
(RLC-parallel circuit ki tareef karein aur us ki aham khususiyaat (key properties) likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
RLC-parallel circuit: woh circuit jis mein resistor R, inductor L aur capacitor C ek doosre ke parallel AC source ke saath jore jate hain. Teeno par voltage ek hi hoti hai aur source ka current branches mein taqseem hota hai.
Aham khususiyaat:
1. Resonance aur impedance: X_L = X_C par resonance hoti hai; tab impedance maximum (Z = R) aur circuit sirf resistive jaisa hota hai. Impedance:
Z = 1/√((1/R)² + (1/X_L − 1/X_C)²)
2. Voltage aur current: sab components par voltage ek hai, is liye usay reference phasor lete hain. Resonance par source ka current minimum hota hai, jab ke branch currents I_L aur I_C us se kahin zyada ho sakte hain (current magnification).
3. Admittance: Y = 1/Z; parallel circuits samajhne ke liye; kul admittance alag alag components ki admittances ka jama hai.
4. Frequency aur bandwidth: impedance, admittance aur currents frequency par depend karte hain; bandwidth frequencies ki woh range hai jis mein circuit theek kaam kare. Resonance frequency:
fᵣ = 1/(2π√LC)
5. Quality factor Q: resonance peak ki tezi (sharpness) ka naap (jama energy ba-muqabla zaya energy). Parallel circuit mein Q = R√(C/L), yani bari R se peak zyada tez.
6. Power factor: frequency aur X_L, X_C ke tanasub par depend karta hai; resonance par 1 (unity).
Istemal: tuning circuits, signal processing, power systems aur induction cooktops (resonant circuit coil mein high-frequency current chalata hai jo dhaat ke bartan ko garam karta hai).

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab 17.13 mein likhti hai ke parallel circuit ka Q-factor resistance ke ulat mutanasib (inversely proportional) hai. Asal mein parallel circuit mein Q = R√(C/L), yani R barhane se Q barhta hai; R ke saath Q ghatna series circuit ki baat hai. Exam mein formula Q = R√(C/L) likhein.

blocks.prompt:
17.4 Find expression for impedance in case of RC and RL-series circuits.
(RC aur RL-series circuits mein impedance ka formula hasil karein.)
blocks.explanation:
(a) RC-series circuit
R aur C AC source ke saath series mein hain, is liye dono mein ek hi current Iᵣₘₛ; current ko reference lein.
R par voltage: V_R = IᵣₘₛR, current ke saath in phase (current ki line par).
C par voltage: V_C = IᵣₘₛX_C = Iᵣₘₛ/ωC, current se 90° peeche (right angle par).
Applied voltage dono ka vector jama hai:
Vᵣₘₛ = √(V_R² + V_C²) = √((IᵣₘₛR)² + (Iᵣₘₛ/ωC)²) = Iᵣₘₛ √(R² + (1/ωC)²)
Impedance Z = Vᵣₘₛ/Iᵣₘₛ = √(R² + (1/ωC)²) = √(R² + X_C²)   (17.21)
Phase angle: θ = tan⁻¹(X_C/R) = tan⁻¹(1/ωCR); current applied voltage se θ aage.
(b) RL-series circuit
R aur L mein ek hi current Iᵣₘₛ.
R par voltage: V_R = IᵣₘₛR, current ke saath in phase (line OA).
L par voltage: V_L = IᵣₘₛX_L = IᵣₘₛωL, current se 90° aage (line OB).
Applied voltage vector jama (line OP):
Vᵣₘₛ = √(V_R² + V_L²) = √((IᵣₘₛR)² + (IᵣₘₛωL)²) = Iᵣₘₛ √(R² + (ωL)²)
Impedance Z = Vᵣₘₛ/Iᵣₘₛ = √(R² + (ωL)²) = √(R² + X_L²)   (17.23)
Phase angle: θ = tan⁻¹(ωL/R); applied voltage current se θ aage.
Dono mein impedance (unit ohm) impedance diagram mein resistance aur reactance ke vector jama se milti hai, aur power P = I²R = VI cos θ.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Yaad rakhne ka tareeqa: "ELI the ICE man". ELI: inductor (L) mein voltage (E) current (I) se pehle. ICE: capacitor (C) mein current (I) voltage (E) se pehle. Impedance hamesha right-angle triangle ka hypotenuse hai: ek side R, doosri side reactance.

blocks.prompt:
17.5 Define full-wave rectification? Draw circuit, input and output signal phasor diagrams to explain how full-wave rectification is achieved by use of full wave bridge rectifier.
(Full-wave rectification ki tareef karein. Full-wave bridge rectifier ka circuit, input aur output signals ke diagrams bana kar samjhayein ke full-wave rectification kaise hoti hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Tareef: jis rectification mein alternating input voltage ke dono halves load resistance mein ek hi simt ka (unidirectional) current bana dein, usay full-wave rectification kehte hain.
Circuit (bridge rectifier) aise banayein:
Chaar diodes D₁, D₂, D₃, D₄ ek band loop (diamond shakal ka "bridge") mein jore jate hain. AC input (transformer ki secondary winding) bridge ke do aamne saamne kono A aur B par lagta hai; load resistance R baqi do kono ke darmiyan. Diodes do "series pairs" banate hain: D₁ aur D₂, D₃ aur D₄; har half-cycle mein sirf ek pair chalta hai.
Kaam:
Positive half-cycle (0 → T/2): A, B ke muqable mein positive. D₁ aur D₂ forward biased ho kar series mein current chalate hain; D₃, D₄ reverse biased. R mein current ek simt mein.
Negative half-cycle (T/2 → T): A negative, B positive. D₃ aur D₄ chalte hain; D₁, D₂ reverse biased (OFF). R mein current phir usi simt mein.
Signals (graphs) aise banayein:
Input: period T ki sine wave, 0 se T/2 positive aur T/2 se T negative.
Output (R par): har half-cycle mein positive hump; negative half-cycles ulat kar positive humps ban jati hain, yani har input cycle mein do pulses (ripple frequency 2f). Current ek simt mein magar pulsating (dharakta hua).
Smoothing: load ke parallel capacitor rectified voltage barhne par charge aur ghatne par discharge hota hai, is liye output taqreeban seedhi DC ban jati hai, thori ripple ke saath: V_ripple = I_DC/(2fC).
Istemal: mobile chargers aur DC power supplies mein full-wave bridge rectifier hota hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Sawal "phasor diagrams" kehta hai, magar yahan muraad input aur output ke waveforms (graphs) hain. Bridge yaad rakhne ka tareeqa: har half-cycle mein current do diodes se guzarta hai, magar load R mein hamesha ek hi simt mein.

blocks.prompt:
17.6 State and explain in detail RLC-series circuit?
(RLC-series circuit ko tafseel se bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
RLC-series circuit: resistor R, inductor L aur capacitor C AC source (badalti frequency) ke saath series mein. Teeno mein ek hi current I.
Phasor (vector) diagram, current reference:
V_R = IR, I ke saath in phase
V_L = IX_L = IωL, I se 90° aage
V_C = IX_C = I/ωC, I se 90° peeche
V_L aur V_C ulat (180° farq) hain, is liye net reactive voltage V_L − V_C. Applied voltage:
V = √(V_R² + (V_L − V_C)²)
Impedance:
Z = V/I = √(R² + (X_L − X_C)²)   (17.24)
Z = √(R² + (ωL − 1/ωC)²)   (17.25)
Phase angle: tan θ = (X_L − X_C)/R = (V_L − V_C)/V_R
Frequency ke saath rawaiya:
Zyada frequency: X_L = ωL ≫ X_C, inductance ghalib; circuit RL-series jaisa (voltage current se aage).
Kam frequency: X_C = 1/ωC ≫ X_L, capacitance ghalib; circuit RC-series jaisa (current voltage se aage).
Resonance: ek frequency par X_L = X_C; dono cancel aur circuit sirf resistive.
ωᵣL = 1/ωᵣC, ωᵣ² = 1/LC, ωᵣ = 1/√LC
fᵣ = 1/(2π√LC)   (17.26)
Aham khususiyaat:
1. Resonance par impedance minimum, Z = R.
2. Resonance par current maximum (impedance minimum).
3. Resonance par phase angle zero: V aur I in phase, power factor 1.
4. Damping: R oscillations ko kam karti hai; bari R zyada damping (car ke pahiye aur spring ka shock absorber).
5. Tuning aur filtering: radio tuning aur band-pass filters.
6. Voltage amplification: resonance par V_L aur V_C applied voltage se kaafi zyada ho sakti hain.
7. Power: P = VI cos θ (true power), θ = 0 par maximum; apparent power VI (volt-ampere).
Example 17.7: V_L = 20 V, V_C = 11 V, V_R = 12 V se tan θ = 9/12 = 0.75, θ = 36.8°, aur V = √(12² + 9²) = 15 V.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab 17.12 mein VI cos θ ko "apparent power" bhi keh deti hai. Sahi yeh hai: VI cos θ = true (asal) power (watts); VI = apparent power (volt-ampere). Exam mein yahi farq likhein.
Numerical Problems (sawal hal karein)

blocks.prompt:
17.1 AC circuit configure by a resistance of 20 Ω, capacitor of capacitance 40 μF is connected to an AC supply of 110 V having frequency 50 Hz. Calculate: (a) capacitive reactance. (b) current in the circuits (c) suggest phase between the voltage and current in a capacitive circuit.
(Ans: (a) 79.58 Ω (b) 1.34A (c) Current leads voltage by 90° or π / 2 rad.)
(20 Ω resistance aur 40 μF capacitor (series mein) 110 V, 50 Hz AC supply se jore gaye hain. (a) capacitive reactance (b) circuit ka current (c) capacitive circuit mein voltage aur current ka phase maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: R = 20 Ω, C = 40 μF = 40 × 10⁻⁶ F, Vᵣₘₛ = 110 V, f = 50 Hz (R aur C series mein)
Maloom karna: (a) X_C (b) Iᵣₘₛ (c) phase
(a) X_C = 1/2πfC
X_C = 1/(2 × 3.1416 × 50 Hz × 40 × 10⁻⁶ F)
X_C = 1/(0.012566 Ω⁻¹)
X_C = 79.58 Ω
(b) RC-series circuit ki impedance:
Z = √(R² + X_C²) = √((20 Ω)² + (79.58 Ω)²)
Z = √(400 + 6332.7) Ω = √6732.7 Ω = 82.05 Ω
Iᵣₘₛ = Vᵣₘₛ/Z = 110 V/82.05 Ω
Iᵣₘₛ = 1.34 A
(c) Capacitive circuit mein current voltage se 90° (π/2 rad) aage: capacitor par I = Iₒ sin (ωt + π/2).
Poore RC circuit ke liye current supply voltage se θ = tan⁻¹(X_C/R) = tan⁻¹(79.58/20) = tan⁻¹(3.98) = 75.9° aage.
Jawab: (a) 79.58 Ω (b) 1.34 A (c) capacitor par current 90° (π/2 rad) aage; poore RC circuit mein 75.9° (kitab se mutabiq).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Sawal mein "configure" aur "circuits" chhapa hai; parhein "configured" aur "circuit". Kitab ka jawab (c) 90° capacitor ke liye hai; poore RC circuit mein current supply voltage se 75.9° aage hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Current nikalne ke liye sirf X_C nahi, poori impedance Z lein, kyun ke R bhi series mein hai: 110 V/79.58 Ω = 1.38 A ghalat hoga. Sahi: 110 V/82.05 Ω = 1.34 A.

blocks.prompt:
17.2 An alternating current I is represented by the equation; I = 420 sin (100 πt).Find (a) the rms current (b) the frequency
(Ans: (a) 296.94 A (b) = 50 Hz)
(Alternating current ki equation I = 420 sin (100 πt) hai. (a) rms current (b) frequency maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: I = 420 sin (100πt); I = Iₒ sin ωt se muqabla karein
Iₒ = 420 A, ω = 100π rad s⁻¹
Maloom karna: (a) Iᵣₘₛ (b) f
(a) Iᵣₘₛ = Iₒ/√2 = 0.707 Iₒ
Iᵣₘₛ = 0.707 × 420 A
Iᵣₘₛ = 296.94 A ≈ 297 A
(b) ω = 2πf, is liye f = ω/2π
f = 100π/2π
f = 50 Hz
Jawab: (a) 296.94 A (b) 50 Hz (kitab se mutabiq; 1/√2 poora lene par Iᵣₘₛ = 296.98 A).

blocks.prompt:
17.3 A 50 Hz AC of peak value 1 A flows through primary coil of a transformer. If the mutual inductance between the primary and secondary be 1.5 H, then find the mean value of induced voltage.
(Ans: 3000 V)
(Transformer ki primary coil mein 50 Hz, peak value 1 A ka AC behta hai. Primary aur secondary ki mutual inductance 1.5 H ho to induced voltage ki mean (average) value maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: f = 50 Hz, Iₒ = 1 A, M = 1.5 H
Maloom karna: mean induced emf ε
Time period: T = 1/f = 1/50 Hz = 0.02 s
Current quarter-cycle mein 0 se peak 1 A tak barhta hai:
Δt = T/4 = 0.02 s/4 = 0.005 s
ΔIₚ = 1 A − 0 = 1 A
Average rate: ΔIₚ/Δt = 1 A/0.005 s = 200 A s⁻¹
Mean induced emf (Eq. 17.41, magnitude):
ε = M ΔIₚ/Δt
ε = 1.5 H × 200 A s⁻¹
ε = 300 V
Check: peak emf = MωIₒ = 1.5 H × 314.2 rad s⁻¹ × 1 A = 471 V; half-cycle ka average = 0.637 × 471 V = 300 V.
Jawab: 300 V (kitab 3000 V chhapti hai; neeche box dekhein).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ka jawab 3000 V chhapa hai. M = 1.5 H, quarter-cycle Δt = T/4 = 0.005 s mein ΔI = 1 A se mean emf ε = MΔI/Δt = 1.5 × 200 = 300 V banti hai (yahi 0.637 × peak emf MωIₒ = 471 V hai). 3000 V ke liye frequency 500 Hz honi chahiye thi.

blocks.prompt:
17.4 A 220 V AC source of frequency 2 kHz is connected across a capacitor of 10 μF. Find out: (a) the reactance X_L of capacitor (b) the current in the circuit.
(Ans: (a) 7.96 Ω (b) 27.63 A)
(220 V, 2 kHz AC source 10 μF capacitor ke across jora gaya hai. (a) capacitor ki reactance (X_C) (b) circuit ka current maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: V = 220 V, f = 2 kHz = 2000 Hz, C = 10 μF = 10 × 10⁻⁶ F
Maloom karna: (a) capacitive reactance X_C (b) I
(a) X_C = 1/2πfC
X_C = 1/(2 × 3.1416 × 2000 Hz × 10 × 10⁻⁶ F)
X_C = 1/(0.12566 Ω⁻¹)
X_C = 7.96 Ω
(b) I = V/X_C
I = 220 V/7.96 Ω
I = 27.64 A ≈ 27.6 A
Jawab: (a) 7.96 Ω (b) 27.6 A (kitab se mutabiq; kitab 27.63 A likhti hai, sirf rounding ka farq).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Sawal mein "reactance X_L of capacitor" chhapa hai. Capacitor ki reactance X_C (capacitive reactance) hoti hai; X_L inductor ki reactance hai.

blocks.prompt:
17.5 In a coil of inductance 150 mH, a current changes steadily from 50 mA to 30 mA in 164 ms, find: (a) the magnitude (b) direction of induced emf.
(Ans: (a) 18.29 mV (b) same direction as the original current.)
(150 mH inductance wali coil mein current 164 ms mein yaksaan tor par 50 mA se 30 mA ho jata hai. Induced emf ki (a) miqdaar (b) simt maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: L = 150 mH = 0.150 H, I₁ = 50 mA, I₂ = 30 mA, Δt = 164 ms = 0.164 s
Maloom karna: (a) |ε| (b) simt
ΔI = I₂ − I₁ = 30 mA − 50 mA = −20 mA = −0.020 A
(a) ε = −L ΔI/Δt   (17.31)
ε = −0.150 H × (−0.020 A/0.164 s)
ε = 0.150 H × 0.1220 A s⁻¹
ε = 0.01829 V = 18.29 mV
(b) Current kam ho raha hai, is liye Lenz's law ke mutabiq induced emf is kami ki mukhalifat karti hai: woh current ko jaari rakhna chahti hai, yani asal current ki simt mein hoti hai (ΔI negative hai to ε positive).
Jawab: (a) 18.29 mV (b) asal current ki simt mein (kitab se mutabiq).

blocks.prompt:
17.6 A choke coil is needed to operate a lamp at 160 Vᵣₘₛ and 50 Hz. The lamp has an resistance of 5 Ω when running at 10 Aᵣₘₛ. Calculate the inductance of the choke coil.
(Ans: 48.4 mH)
(160 Vᵣₘₛ, 50 Hz par lamp chalane ke liye choke coil chahiye. 10 Aᵣₘₛ par chalte hue lamp ki resistance 5 Ω hai. Choke coil ki inductance maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: Vᵣₘₛ = 160 V, f = 50 Hz, R = 5 Ω (lamp), Iᵣₘₛ = 10 A; choke (pure inductor) lamp ke saath series mein
Maloom karna: L
Lamp par voltage: V_R = IR = 10 A × 5 Ω = 50 V
RL-series circuit mein: V² = V_R² + V_L²
V_L = √(V² − V_R²) = √((160 V)² − (50 V)²)
V_L = √(25600 − 2500) V = √23100 V = 152 V
X_L = V_L/I = 152 V/10 A = 15.2 Ω
X_L = 2πfL, is liye L = X_L/2πf
L = 15.2 Ω/(2 × 3.1416 × 50 Hz)
L = 15.2 Ω/314.16 s⁻¹
L = 0.0484 H = 48.4 mH
Jawab: L = 48.4 mH (kitab se mutabiq).

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Ghalti se 160 V − 50 V = 110 V na lein. Lamp (R) aur choke (L) ki voltages mein 90° ka farq hai, is liye inhen Pythagoras ki tarah jorte hain: V² = V_R² + V_L².
Mukhtasar khulasa
